units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 23a:5">B. Kam. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>לא ט׳ באפיה</he> (Ms. H. <he>טפא</he>, v. <he>טְפֵי</he> IV) he did not carefully close (the stable) before him.

senses.gloss: to slap, strike with hand, stamp with foot.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 19:24">Targ. II Kings XIX, 24</cite>; <cite ref="Isaiah 37:25">Is. XXXVII, 25</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 21:17">Targ. Ez. XXI, 17</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 21:19">19</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jonah 4:8">Targ. Jon. IV, 8</cite> <he>ט׳ שמשא וכ׳</he> the sun beat upon &c.—
